notes.title: Patch 01.03
notes.notes:
[h3]PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various performance fixes
[*] Fixed Shroud and Takedown sometimes becoming unavailable
[*] Fixed occurrence of Agitator failing to die when their health reaches 0
[*] Fixed music sometimes playing twice
[/list]
 
[h3]CHARACTER ANIMATION:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Azad sliding after skipping certain cinematics in chapter Chamatkari Mandir
[*] Fixed Luther sometimes floating during combat in chapter Quinta Matos
[*] Fixed player sometimes getting stuck in chapter Anatolia
[*] Fixed not being able to climb down a climbable wall in chapter Peshanden
[*] Fixed Buchra sliding after a cinematic in chapter Reithden
[*] Fixed a rare issue of passing through the world when attempting to heal and climb at the same time
[/list]

[h3]LOCALIZATION:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue of an incorrect language sometimes being used when booting the game for the first time
[*] Multiple fixes on Japanese and English subtitles
[*] Fixed missing subtitles for the Relay Tower warning
[*] Renaming of some UI elements to clarify their purpose
[/list]

notes.title: Unknown 9: Awakening studio makes major layoffs just a month after the game's release
notes.notes: month after the release of its debut game Unknown 9: Awakening, Bandai Namco-owned Reflector Entertainment has announced that it is laying off 18% of its workforce so it can "efficiently deliver on our most pressing objectives while guaranteeing that every member of our team can meaningfully contribute to our ongoing projects."..
